About Arkham

Arkham is an on-chain intelligence platform that labels blockchain addresses and entities, and also runs a crypto exchange. ARKM is its utility token.

Where this ARKM price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (ARKM-USD), Binance (ARKM/USDT) and Kraken (ARKM/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 496,228,000 ARKM (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
